title: Hiiibrand Awards 2026 - Brand & Communication Design
description: Enter brand, logo, packaging, typography, or digital design work in the 17th Hiiibrand Brand and Communication Design Awards.
descriptionDetailed: The Hiiibrand International Brand and Communication Design Awards 2026 celebrates brand and design excellence across nine categories, from Branding and Logo to Packaging, Digital Media, and the new AI Visual category. Professional and student levels welcome emerging talent, judged for Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Merit distinctions.

entry.feeNote: Design Awards fees vary by level and category. Regular fees (August 1-31) are $80 for professional Branding and $40 for student Branding; other categories are $48/$80 for professional single/series and $24/$40 for student single/series. Super early bird (by June 30) offers 50% savings and early bird (by July 31) 25%. Brand Awards entry is free of charge.

prize.prizeSummary: Kaleidoscope trophy + award certificates + touring exhibitions + online promotion
prize.description: Design Awards recognize Gold, Silver, Bronze, and Merit winners in professional and student levels across nine categories, including the new AI Visual category. Brand Awards honor companies and organizations, with the Best Brand Award receiving a trophy. Winners of the Bronze Award or higher receive a Kaleidoscope trophy, electronic certificates are provided free of charge, and winning and shortlisted works may be featured in touring exhibitions and promoted across Hiiibrand's media channels and partner publications.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For professional designers, agencies, and students worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open globally to professional agencies, studios, design teams, marketing departments, freelancers, and rights-holding brands, as well as graduate, undergraduate, college, and technical-school students. Professional entries must be commissioned and actually applied; student entries may be graduation projects or school assignments. Work must have been created or published between January 1, 2024 and August 31, 2026, and AI Visual entries must demonstrate at least 30% substantive AI involvement with tools and process disclosed.
